rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a lack of order and for a situation thrown into chaos.

example.english: The whole room is in disorder, so tidy it up.
example.traditional: 成個房間都係混亂，快啲執下啦。
example.jyutping: seng4 go3 fong2 gaan1 dou1 hai6 wan6 lyun6 faai3 di1 zap1 haa5 laa1

rows.note: Use this everyday broad medical noun for a physical or mental condition rather than a technical diagnosis.

example.english: I don't know what disorder they have, but they suffer from insomnia all the time.
example.traditional: 我唔知佢有咩病，但係成日失眠。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 jau5 me1 beng6 daan6 hai6 seng4 jat6 sat1 min4

rows.note: Use this for public unrest or a disturbance of civic peace, especially in news or formal descriptions.

example.english: Police said the disorder had subsided.
example.traditional: 警方表示，騷亂已經平息。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 biu2 si6 sou1 lyun6 ji5 ging1 ping4 sik1
